en.summary: Crohn's is an inflammatory bowel disease causing diarrhoea, abdominal pain, weight loss, sometimes blood/mucus. NHS: GP/gastroenterology for diagnosis. Flare with severe pain, high fever, persistent vomiting, or heavy bleeding needs urgent care. Immunosuppressants/biologics are specialist-prescribed only.
emergencyIf: Signs of obstruction (severe bloating, no stool/gas, vomiting)
seeDoctorIf: Persistent diarrhoea, pain, weight loss, blood in stool
doNot: Do not stop prescribed IBD medicines without advice

fr.summary: La maladie de Crohn est une MICI. Médecin/gastro. Urgence si douleur sévère, fièvre, vomissements, saignement abondant. Pas de biothérapies inventées.

he.summary: קרוהן היא מחלת מעי דלקתית. רופא/גסטרו. חירום בכאב חזק, חום, הקאות, דימום כבד. אין ביולוגיים מומצאים.

ru.summary: Болезнь Крона — ВЗК. К врачу/гастро. Неотложка при сильной боли, лихорадке, рвоте, обильном кровотечении. Биопрепараты не выдумывать.
